verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an API reference listing for a POST /resume endpoint that resumes crew execution with human feedback. Together with kickoff and status endpoints, this implies a pause-for-human-feedback-and-resume loop, apparently on the deployed (AMP) REST API. A competitor founder claims CrewAI lacks pause hooks, but that is an opinion rather than a concrete hands-on failure, so it lowers confidence without creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation of how an agent pauses mid-run for input or approval, open-source framework support (not just the deployed API), approval gating semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
